blocks.text: Restore and protect your faded, sun-damaged outdoor belongings and furniture with Rejuvenate® Outdoor Restorer. This technologically advanced formula penetrates deep to restore faded and weathered outdoor surfaces. With a multi-surface formula that restores vinyl, plastic, stone and metal, this product can be used on car bumpers, siding, grills, shutters and outdoor patio furniture. Easily wipe it on to eliminate that years-old, worn-out look and enhance the appearance of outdoor surfaces. Rejuvenate® Outdoor Restorer covers up to 800 square feet and protects surfaces from fading and sun damage. Always test on an inconspicuous area first. Apply in a cool, shaded, dry area. Never apply to a hot surface. First, clean the surface with soap and water to remove debris, stains or other residue. Allow surface to dry thoroughly. Next, pour a small amount of Rejuvenate® Outdoor Restorer onto surface. Apply with light pressure in a single wipe to the intended surface with little or no overlap, from one row to the next, until the surface is completely coated. For faded or very porous surfaces, a second coat may be required for optimal results. If applicable, allow the first coat to dry for 24 hours before applying a second coat.
